name: Turker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S.
summary: Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. develops real estate properties in Turkey. The company was formerly known as Mutlu Yatirim Proje ve Gayrimenkul Gelistirme A.S. and changed its name to Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. in May 2015. Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. is a subsidiary of Türker Yatirim Holding A.S.
